units: <cite ref="Berakhot 56a:19">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>אפתחא דריש ט׳</he> (Ar. <cite ref="I00742"><he>טרזיא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="I00221">preced.</cite>) at the entrance of the chief treasury; [prob. to be read: <he>דבי ט׳</he>, <cite ref="D01092"><he>דריש</he></cite> having come in by tautography from the suceeding <he>ריש טורזיא</he>.]—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 8a:16">B. Bath. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>לשורא … ולטר׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. F. <he>טורדינא</he>, Alf. Ms. <he>טורדיתא</he>) for the maintenance of the town-wall, the horse-guard and the armory even orphans must contribute.
<cite ref="Eruvin 80a:18">Erub. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>ההוא ט׳ וכ׳</he> (ed. Sonc. <he>טורזיינא</he>) there was a (gentile) superintendent that lived in the neighborhood &c.
